# Artifact Keeper 1.11.8

A maintenance release on the 1.11 line: 8 changelog entries from 7 pull requests since 1.11.7, all backported from `main` in #5003, #5027, #5028, #5029, #5031 and #5024. The headlines are **Renovate and other clients that configure a bare API token can list Docker tags again** (#4903, in #4977), because `/v2/token` now accepts an API token in the Bearer slot, and **NuGet V3 search over a virtual repository of several V2 remotes reports every member's versions and the latest stable version** (#4976, in #4979). Next to them: chunked uploads now apply the storage quota and the upload quarantine hold like native uploads, an LDAP web login no longer reactivates an account an administrator deactivated, a proxy rescan that cannot grade a package archive keeps the stored verdict, a repository's security score no longer goes stale when two scans finish together, and `zstd` moves to 0.14.3. **No schema migrations** (the line stays at migration 289) and no new settings. Upgrading is a normal image bump.

## What changed

- **`/v2/token` accepts an API token presented as a Bearer credential** (#4903, in #4977). The token exchange recognized only JWTs in that slot and answered `401`, so Renovate and other clients configured with a bare API token failed their `tags/list` request. They now get a registry token as they do with Basic credentials.
- **NuGet V3 search aggregates versions across the members of a virtual repository** (#4976, in #4979). With several NuGet V2 remotes behind one virtual repository, search kept whichever member answered first and paged V2 version rows before grouping them, so it could show an older version and leave out versions held by other members. Search now groups versions before paging, merges duplicate package IDs, and recalculates the reported version under the requested prerelease policy.
- **Chunked uploads apply the storage quota and the upload quarantine hold** (#5003). An artifact committed through `PUT /api/v1/uploads/{id}/complete` into a hosted repository with the upload quarantine enabled is now held, as one uploaded through the format's native route is. The quota check at session creation and the quota admission at completion now exempt a session only when it is a replication session of an administrator or service account.
- **An LDAP web login keeps an administrator's deactivation of an account** (#4933, in #5029). A successful directory bind on the web LDAP login used to set a deactivated account active again. The login of a deactivated LDAP account is now refused, and an administrator reactivates the account explicitly.
- **A proxy rescan that cannot grade a package archive leaves the stored verdict unchanged** (#3396, in #5030). For npm tarballs, PyPI sdists, gems, crates, NuGet packages and OCI image manifests, a rescan whose scanner cataloged no components now answers `503` `RESCAN_SCAN_FAILED` and keeps the stored verdict instead of recording `clean`. For every format, a rescan that cataloged fewer components than the stored verdict was graded on no longer replaces it.
- **A repository's security score no longer goes stale when two of its scans finish at the same time** (#5006, in #5007). Score recalculations of one repository now run one at a time under a per-repository database lock and retry on a serialization failure, so the stored grade and severity counts include every completed scan. Before, one of two concurrent recalculations could store a score that missed the other scan, which could show as a false F until the next scan.

### Security

- **`zstd` updated to 0.14.3** (#5023). `zstd` and the async compression codecs move onto the zstd 0.14 / `zstd-safe` 8.2 stack, which carries the upstream fixes for RUSTSEC-2026-0391, RUSTSEC-2026-0398 and RUSTSEC-2026-0403. An older zstd 0.13 copy remains through `rattler_package_streaming` and wasmtime's compilation cache, where the affected functions are not reachable; those RUSTSEC entries are ignored in `.cargo/audit.toml` until both crates move to zstd 0.14. Lockfile-only, with no behaviour change.

## Upgrade notes

A normal image bump. There is no migration and no new or changed setting. Two behaviours operators may notice:

- An LDAP account that an administrator deactivated stays deactivated after its user signs in through the web LDAP login; reactivate it from the user administration page or API when that is intended.
- An artifact uploaded through the chunked upload API into a repository with the upload quarantine enabled is now held like any other upload, and a chunked upload counts against the repository's storage quota unless it is a replication session of an administrator or service account.

The full entries are in the `## [1.11.8]` section of [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/artifact-keeper/artifact-keeper/blob/v1.11.8/CHANGELOG.md).
